comparison

allow

Ex: Uprooting trees will disturb any archaeological remains below ground level.

artifact

(noun). hiện vật

Ex: The museum has artifacts dating back to prehistoric times.

assembly

(noun). sự lắp ráp

Ex: Putting the bookcase together should be a simple assembly job.

conflict

(noun). Xung đột

Ex: The violence was the result of political and ethnic conflicts.

contain

(verb). Chứa đựng

Ex: This drink doesn't contain any alcohol.

contrast

(noun). Sự tương phản

Ex: The flowers provide a contrast with the dark background.

currently

(adverb). tại thời điểm hiện tại

Ex: All the options are currently available.

dismantle

(verb). tháo gỡ

Ex: The steel mill was dismantled piece by piece.

elaborate

(adjective). kỹ lưỡng

Ex: She had prepared a very elaborate meal.

enable

(verb). Cho phép

Ex: This new programme will enable older people to study at college.

entire

(adjective). toàn bộ

Ex: You two are her favourite people in the entire world.

excavation

(noun). sự khai quật

Ex: More discoveries were made as the excavation proceeded.

foundation

(noun). Nền móng

Ex: The builders are now beginning to lay the foundations of the new school.

literally

(adverb). Theo nghĩa đen

military

(noun). lực lượng quân sự

Ex:

ritual

(noun). nghi thức

Ex: This is the most ancient, and holiest of the Shinto rituals.

ruins

(noun). đống đổ nát

Ex: We visited the ruins of a Norman castle.

rule

(verb). cai trị

Ex: At that time, King John ruled England.

sophistication

(noun). sự tinh xảo

Ex: The sophistication of computers is increasing.

uncover

(verb). khám phá

Ex: It will be difficult to uncover the truth.

unearth

(verb). phát hiện, đưa ra ánh sáng

unification

(noun). thống nhất

Ex: Progress towards economic unification remains limited.

unparalleled

(adjective). Không gì sánh bằng

Ex: It was an unparalleled opportunity to develop his career.

weaponry

(noun). vũ khí

Ex: He had a large collection of medieval and historical weaponry.

accurate

(adjective). Chính xác

Ex: Accurate measurements are essential.

confirm

(verb). Xác nhận

Ex: His guilty expression confirmed my suspicions.

constitute

(verb). Cấu tạo nên

Ex: Female workers constitute the majority of the labour force.

grave goods

(noun). những món đồ được chôn cùng với những ngôi mộ cổ

Ex: No grave goods were found in association with the skeletons.

possess

(verb). Sở hữu

Ex: I'm afraid this is the only suitcase I possess.

prove

(verb). Chứng minh

Ex: She was determined to prove everyone wrong.

record

(noun). ghi chép

Ex: You should keep a record of your expenses.

discover

(verb). Khám phá

Ex: She recently discovered two fungi that were new to science.

tomb

(noun). ngôi mộ

Ex: The tomb was honeycombed with passages and chambers.

corpse

(noun). xác chết

Ex: The corpse had lain preserved in the soil for almost two millennia.

evidence

(noun). Bằng chứng

Ex: Researchers have found clear scientific evidence of a link between exposure to sun and skin cancer.

identify

(verb). Xác định, nhận dạng

Ex: They are trying to identify what is wrong with the present system.

remains

(noun). tàn tích

Ex: The museum has an impressive collection of prehistoric remains.

sacrifice

(noun). sự cúng thần, tế lễ

Ex: They offered sacrifices to the gods.

skeleton

(noun). bộ xương

Ex: We found an old sheep skeleton up on the cliffs.

accidentally

(adverb). tình cờ

Ex: The damage couldn't have been caused accidentally.

be riddled with something

(adjective). đầy

Ex: Her typing was slow and riddled with mistakes.

by chance

(adverb). tình cờ

Ex: I met her by chance at the airport.

drought

(noun). Hạn hán

Ex: England has had several summer droughts in recent years.

comparison

(noun). sự so sánh

Ex: The films are too different for a fair comparison.

size

(noun). kích thước

Ex: He was about the same size as me.

variety

(noun). Sự đa dạng

Ex: This tool can be used in a variety of ways.

wood

(noun). gỗ

Ex: He gathered some wood to build a fire.

hub

(noun). trục bánh xe

Ex: Eventually though, I end up with shredded hubs, broken spokes and cracked rims.

construct

(verb). xây dựng

Ex: You must learn how to construct a logical argument.

cover

(verb). bao phủ

Ex: Snow covered the ground.

drill

(verb). khoan

Ex: Drill a series of holes in the frame.

lubricate

(verb). bôi trơn

Ex: A car engine needs to be well lubricated with oil.

aim

(verb). nhắm vào, hướng vào

Ex: The government is aiming at a 50% reduction in unemployment.

leather

(noun). chất liệu bằng da

Ex: I'm looking for a pair of boots in dark brown leather.

retain

(verb). Giữ lại

Ex: He struggled to retain control of the situation.

spoke

(noun). căm xe

Ex: Eventually though, I end up with shredded hubs, broken spokes and cracked rims.

vary

(verb). Thay đổi, khác nhau

Ex: The students' work varies considerably in quality.

wheel

(noun). bánh xe

Ex: He braked suddenly, causing the front wheels to skid.

advanced

(adjective). hiện đại, nâng cao

Ex: Sweden has a reputation for advanced and stylish design.

ancient

(adjective). cổ đại

Ex: People have lived in this valley since ancient times.

asset

(noun). Tài sản

Ex: Her assets include shares in the company and a house in France.

flat

(adjective). bằng phẳng

Ex: I need a flat surface to write on.

outstanding

(adjective). vượt bậc

Ex: That was a quite outstanding performance!

resemble

(verb). Tạo hình giống nhau

Ex: The plant resembles grass in appearance.

rim

(noun). vành

Ex: Eventually though, I end up with shredded hubs, broken spokes and cracked rims.

strengthen

(verb). Làm cho chắc chắn

Ex: Repairs are necessary to strengthen the bridge.

edge

(noun). góc cạnh

Ex: I gripped the edge of my desk to steady myself.

wrap

(verb). bọc, bao

Ex: I wrapped the baby up in a blanket.

appearance

(noun). sự xuất hiện

Ex: Since its first appearance in the 19th century, cholera has killed millions.

curve

(verb). cong, uốn cong

Ex: The road curved around the bay.

efficient

(adjective). Hiệu quả

Ex: We offer a fast, friendly and efficient service.

harness

(noun). yên cương

Ex: The sight of horses in harness hauling timber was common a hundred years ago.

incredibly

(adverb). đáng kinh ngạc, đến không ngờ

Ex: It was all incredibly difficult.

release

(verb). thả ra

Ex: He refused to release her arm.

chariot

(noun). xe ngựa kéo

Ex: The moons of Mars are named for the mythical horses that drew the chariot of Mars, the god of war.

measure

(verb). Đo lường

Ex: Blood pressure and heart rate should be measured before treatment.

researcher

(noun). Nhà nghiên cứu

Ex: Researchers found there was no evidence of an increased risk of infection.

surface

(noun). bề mặt

Ex: Teeth have a hard surface layer called enamel.

afterlife

(noun). sự tồn tại sau khi chết

Ex: Most Christians believe in an afterlife of some sort, often referred to as heaven.

bury

(verb). chôn

Ex: The king is dead and lies buried at Jedburgh Abbey.

complex

(adjective). Phức tạp

Ex: We live in an increasingly complex world.

emperor

(noun). hoàng đế

Ex: He'd dressed himself up as a Roman emperor for the fancy-dress party.

opulent

(adjective). sang trọng

Ex: He lived an opulent lifestyle that included sports cars and enormous homes.

sections.title: Passage 3: Stealth Forces in Weight Loss
sections.html:
willpower

(noun). ý chí

Ex: He’s intelligent but he’s got no willpower.

stealth

(adjective). lén lút

Ex: These products work in stealth mode, so that the people being spied on are totally unaware.

secrete

(verb). tiết ra, sản ra

Ex: More saliva is secreted while chewing.

refined

(adjective). Đã được tinh chỉnh

Ex: Avoid foods rich in fat or refined sugar.

prerogative

(noun). đặc quyền

Ex: In many countries education is still the prerogative of the rich.

predispose

(verb). ảnh hưởng, dẫn dắt

Ex: Some people assumed he was stupid and were thus predisposed to fall into one of his traps.

predetermine

(verb). xác định trước

Ex: The sex of the embryo is predetermined at fertilization.

plummet

(verb). tụt, lao thẳng xuống

Ex: Her spirits plummeted at the thought of meeting him again.

overabundance

(noun). sự thừa mứa, sự thừa thãi

Ex: Many new parents find themselves with an overabundance of cute clothes, but spend a small fortune on diapers and wipes in the first few months.

moderate

(adjective). vừa phải

Ex: Even moderate amounts of the drug can be fatal.

miracle

(noun). phép màu

Ex: It would take a miracle to make this business profitable.

metabolism

(noun). sự trao đổi chất

Ex: The body's metabolism is slowed down by extreme cold.

investigate

(verb). Điều tra

Ex: Detectives are currently investigating possible links between the murders.

inhibit

(verb). khắc chế

Ex: This drug inhibits the growth of tumours.

inevitably

(adverb). Không tránh khỏi

Ex: In fact, every attempt to make it do so must inevitably fail.

incompatible

(adjective). Không tương hợp

Ex: The hours of the job are incompatible with family life.

gut

(noun). ruột

Ex: Meat stays in the gut longer than vegetable matter.

formula

(noun). công thức

Ex: There's no magic formula for success.

fable

(noun). ngụ ngôn

Ex: the fable of the tortoise and the hare Ex: It's an odd but satisfying little fable about loss and loneliness.

extract

(verb). chiết xuất

Ex: a machine that extracts excess moisture from the air

espouse

(verb). theo, chọn

Ex: They espoused the notion of equal opportunity for all in education.

equivalent

(noun). vật tương đương

Ex: Send €20 or the equivalent in your own currency.

encounter

(verb). chạm trán, gặp gỡ

Ex: We encountered a number of difficulties in the first week.

distribute

(verb). phân bổ, phân phối

Ex: Generous workspaces must be well distributed throughout the library.

dimension

(noun). chiều

Ex: Her job added a new dimension to her life.

differentiate

(verb). Tách biệt rõ ràng

Ex: I can't differentiate one variety from another.

desensitise

(verb). làm nhờn đi, làm thờ ơ

Ex: People are increasingly becoming desensitized to violence on television.

crucial

(adjective). Tối quan trọng

Ex: Parents play a crucial role in preparing their child for school.

counselling

(noun). tư vấn

Ex: The couple decided to go for relationship counselling.

conserve

(verb). Bảo quản

Ex: The funds raised will help conserve endangered meadowlands

complication

(noun). biến chứng

Ex: She developed complications after the surgery.

complicated

(adjective). Phức tạp

Ex: It's all very complicated—but I'll try and explain.

bafflingly

(verb). một cách khó hiểu, gây bối rối

Ex: For some reason everyone sees that and thinks it's exactly how it should be, but it's actually bafflingly irrelevant.

ancient

(adjective). cổ đại

Ex: People have lived in this valley since ancient times.

abdominal

(adjective). liên quan đến bụng

Ex: This exercise works your abdominal muscles.

gain

(verb). tăng thêm

Ex: I've gained weight recently.

evaluation

(noun). Sự đánh giá

Ex: The technique is not widely practised and requires further evaluation.

effect

(noun). tác động, ảnh hưởng

Ex: What are the long-term effects of this treatment?

weight loss

(noun). sự giảm cân

Ex: Weight loss can be achieved by balancing a healthy level of physical activity with eating a nutritious diet.

diet

(noun). Chế độ ăn uống

Ex: I loved the Japanese diet of rice, vegetables and fish.

relative

(noun). họ hàng, bà con thân thuộc

Ex: She's caring for an elderly relative.

obese

(adjective). béo phì

Ex: Obese patients are given dietary advice.

according to

(preposition). theo

Ex: The salary will be fixed according to qualifications and experience.

participant

(noun). người tham gia

Ex: He has been an active participant in the discussion.

pregnant

(adjective). có thai

Ex: I was pregnant with our third child at the time.

overweight

(adjective). thừa cân

Ex: She was only a few pounds overweight.

shed

(verb). bỏ, loại bỏ

Ex: She was determined to shed some weight and get fit.

select

(verb). chọn lọc

Ex: He hasn't been selected for the team.

immediately

(adverb). ngay lập tức

Ex: They immediately began arguing.

cue

(noun). gợi ý

Ex: Jon's arrival was a cue for more champagne.

tolerate

(verb). chịu đựng được

Ex: Few plants will tolerate sudden changes in temperature.

stand

(verb). đứng vững, chịu đựng được

Ex: Our tent won't stand another storm like the last one.

majority

(noun). phần đa số

Ex: The majority of people interviewed prefer TV to radio.

hunger

(noun). cơn đói, tình trạng đói

Ex: The organization works to alleviate world hunger and disease.

compare

(verb). so sánh

Ex: We compared the two reports carefully.

chronic

(adjective). Mãn tính

Ex: chronic diseases/conditions Ex: There is a chronic shortage of teachers.

acceptable

(adjective). có thể chấp nhận được

Ex: It is perfectly acceptable for you as an employee to say no.

appear to

(verb). dường như, có vẻ như

Ex: The couple appeared to have nothing in common.

obesity

(noun). béo phì

Ex: Obesity can increase the risk of heart disease.

resort

(noun). cứu cánh, phương kế cuối cùng

Ex: There are hopes that the conflict can be resolved without resort to violence.

practical

(adjective). Thực tiễn

Ex: He offered her some practical advice.

hereditary

(adjective). di truyền

Ex: It’s a hereditary disorder that can cause abnormal growth.

continuous

(adjective). liên tục

Ex: The organization aims to create a culture of continuous improvement .

application

(noun). ứng dụng

Ex: The design has many applications.

experiment

(noun). thử nghiệm

Ex: Some people believe that experiments on animals should be banned.

isolate

(verb). cô lập

Ex: This decision will isolate the country from the rest of Europe.

goal

(noun). Mục đích, mục tiêu

Ex: My job is to help businesses meet their goals.

womb

(noun). tử cung, dạ con

Ex: A scan determines the position of the baby in the womb.

optimal

(adjective). tối ưu

Ex: The optimal temperature for the development of larvae is in the range 18–26˚C.

negotiation

(noun). thương lượng, đàm phán

Ex: The issue is still under negotiation.

interaction

(noun). sự tương tác

Ex: There's not enough interaction between the management and the workers.

influence

(verb). ảnh hưởng

Ex: His film is heavily influenced by other film-makers.

endocrinologist

(noun). bác sĩ chuyên khoa nội tiết

Ex: He is a well-respected endocrinologist who specializes in treating both Type I and Type II diabetes.

determine

(verb). Quyết định

Ex: Upbringing plays an important part in determining a person's character.

process

(noun). quá trình

Ex: It's a normal part of the learning process.

metabolic

(adjective). Thuộc về hệ trao đổi chất

Ex: a metabolic process/disorder Ex: From a metabolic perspective, threonine is one of three indispensable amino acids.

maternal

(adjective). thuộc về phía mẹ

Ex: She didn't have any maternal instincts.

diabetes

(noun). tiểu đường

Ex: People with excess body fat have a greater risk for such illnesses as diabetes and hypertension.

numerous

(adjective). vô số

Ex: He has been late on numerous occasions.

implication

(noun). sự liên can, hậu quả

Ex: They failed to consider the wider implications of their actions.

fetus

(noun). thai nhi

Ex: How well a woman and the fetus do during pregnancy depends upon the type of heart problem.

establish

(verb). Thiết lập

Ex: Let’s establish some ground rules.

directly

(adverb). một cách trực tiếp

Ex: He was not directly responsible for the accident.

risk

(noun). rủi ro

Ex: The health risks are very low.

whittle down

(verb). làm giảm

Ex: I finally managed to whittle down the names on the list to only five.

vastly

(adverb). rộng lớn

Ex: The quality of the training has vastly improved.

give up

(verb). từ bỏ

Ex: They gave up without a fight.

geneticist

(noun). Nhà nghiên cứu về di truyền học

Ex: Alternatively, collaborations with geneticists in universities or medical school settings could facilitate the application of these techniques.

aim

(noun). mục đích, mục tiêu

Ex: Our main aim is to provide affordable childcare.

radical

(adjective). triệt để, cực đoan

Ex: They described themselves as a radical feminists.

psychologist

(noun). Nhà tâm lý học

Ex: I made an appointment with the school psychologist

lifestyle

(noun). cách sống, lối sống

Ex: Too many children are living a completely sedentary lifestyle.

blood pressure

(noun). huyết áp

Ex: The nurse will take your blood pressure in a moment.

necessary

(adjective). cần thiết

Ex: Food is necessary for survival.

various

(adjective). khác nhau, đa dạng

Ex: We talked about jobs, family, football and various other things.

theory

(noun). Giả thuyết; học thuyết

Ex: He has a theory that the hole was caused by a meteorite.

subscribe to something

(verb). tán thành

Ex: The authorities no longer subscribe to the view that disabled people are unsuitable as teachers.

point of view

(noun). quan điểm

Ex: There are a number of different points of view on this issue.

medical

(adjective). Liên quan đến y khoa

Ex: His medical records showed that he was unfit for work.

divide

(verb). Phân chia

Ex: The questions divide into two categories: easy and hard.

attribute

(verb). cho là do, quy cho

Ex: He attributes his success to hard work and a little luck.

uninfected

(adjective). Không bị lây nhiễm, không bị nhiễm

Ex: This could, however, indicate that female mice are active in mate choice as uninfected males were also chosen more often as mates.

treat

(verb). chữa

Ex: She was treated for depression with medication prescribed by her doctor.

svelte

(adjective). mảnh dẻ

Ex: She was svelte and sophisticated.

conduct

(verb). tiến hành

Ex: Police conducted a thorough search of the building.

concept

(noun). khái niệm, ý tưởng

Ex: the concept that everyone should have equality of opportunity

come up with

(verb). nghĩ ra, nảy ra

Ex: She came up with a new idea for increasing sales.

suddenly

(adverb). đột ngột

Ex: I suddenly became aware of just how late it was.

significant

(adjective). Đáng lưu ý, quan trọng

Ex: There are no significant differences between the two groups of students.

prove

(verb). Chứng minh

Ex: She was determined to prove everyone wrong.

induce

(verb). gây ra, đem lại

Ex: Hearing loss is often induced by exposure to loud noise.

identify

(verb). Xác định, nhận dạng

Ex: They are trying to identify what is wrong with the present system.

exposure

(noun). sự tiếp xúc

Ex: You should always limit your exposure to the sun.

breakthrough

(noun). Bước đột phá

Ex: Scientists are hoping for a breakthrough in the search for a cure for cancer.

bona fide

(adjective). thực

Ex: Is it a bona fide, reputable organization?

separate

(verb). chia tách

Ex: South America and Africa separated 200 million years ago.

eliminate

(verb). loại bỏ

Ex: This diet claims to eliminate toxins from the body.

effectiveness

(noun). sự có hiệu lực, sự hiệu quả

Ex: There are doubts about the effectiveness of the new drug in treating the disease.

block

(verb). chặn, làm trở ngại

Ex: He accused the French of trying to block the agreement.

trigger

(verb). gây ra

Ex: Nuts can trigger off a violent allergic reaction.

sufficient

(adjective). Đủ

Ex: Is $100 sufficient for your expenses?

effectively

(adverb). một cách hiệu quả

Ex: Managers must be able to work effectively in a cooperative setting.

combat

(verb). đấu tranh

Ex: We must try to combat poverty and illiteracy.

aim

(verb). nhắm vào, hướng vào

Ex: The government is aiming at a 50% reduction in unemployment.
